Introduction

Episode is a five-member girl group under Pops Entertainment. Originally known as Vitamin Angel, they debuted on June 6, 2015.

Pops Entertainment announced the group would start promoting under the name Episode on October 30, 2019. They re-debuted on February 4, 2020 with the single "Open My Door".
